\brief Complete a buffer for a request
 * \param[in] request The request the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The buffer that has completed
 *
 * This function shall be called by pipeline handlers to signal completion of
 * the \a buffer part of the \a request. It notifies applications of buffer
 * completion and updates the request's internal buffer tracking. The request
 * is not completed automatically when the last buffer completes to give
 * pipeline handlers a chance to perform any operation that may still be
 * needed. They shall complete requests explicitly with completeRequest().
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return True if all buffers contained in the request have completed, false
 * otherwise
 */
bool PipelineHandler::completeBuffer

\brief Signal request completion
 * \param[in] request The request that has completed
 *
 * The pipeline handler shall call this function to notify the \a camera that
 * the request has completed. The request is no longer managed by the pipeline
 * handler and shall not be accessed once this function returns.
 *
 * This function ensures that requests will be returned to the application in
 * submission order, the pipeline handler may call it on any complete request
 * without any ordering constraint.
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::completeRequest

\brief Signal request completion
 * \param[in] request The request that has completed
 *
 * The pipeline handler shall call this function to notify the \a camera that
 * the request has completed. The request is no longer managed by the pipeline
 * handler and shall not be accessed once this function returns.
 *
 * This function ensures that requests will be returned to the application in
 * submission order, the pipeline handler may call it on any complete request
 * without any ordering constraint.
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::completeRequest

\brief Queue a request to the camera
 * \param[in] request The request to queue to the camera
 *
 * This function queues a \a request to the camera for capture.
 *
 * After allocating the request with createRequest(), the application shall
 * fill it with at least one capture buffer before queuing it. Requests that
 * contain no buffers are invalid and are rejected without being queued.
 *
 * Once the request has been queued, the camera will notify its completion
 * through the \ref requestCompleted signal.
 *
 * \context This function is \threadsafe. It may only be called when the camera
 * is in the Running state as defined in \ref camera_operation.
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -ENODEV The camera has been disconnected from the system
 * \retval -EACCES The camera is not running so requests can't be queued
 * \retval -EXDEV The request does not belong to this camera
 * \retval -EINVAL The request is invalid
 * \retval -ENOMEM No buffer memory was available to handle the request
 */
int Camera::queueRequest

\brief Queue a request to the camera
 * \param[in] request The request to queue to the camera
 *
 * This function queues a \a request to the camera for capture.
 *
 * After allocating the request with createRequest(), the application shall
 * fill it with at least one capture buffer before queuing it. Requests that
 * contain no buffers are invalid and are rejected without being queued.
 *
 * Once the request has been queued, the camera will notify its completion
 * through the \ref requestCompleted signal.
 *
 * \context This function is \threadsafe. It may only be called when the camera
 * is in the Running state as defined in \ref camera_operation.
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -ENODEV The camera has been disconnected from the system
 * \retval -EACCES The camera is not running so requests can't be queued
 * \retval -EXDEV The request does not belong to this camera
 * \retval -EINVAL The request is invalid
 * \retval -ENOMEM No buffer memory was available to handle the request
 */
int Camera::queueRequest

Functions that affect the camera state as defined below are generally not
 * synchronized with each other by the Camera class. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring their synchronization if necessary.
 *
 * \subsection Camera States

\brief Signal request completion
 * \param[in] request The request that has completed
 *
 * The pipeline handler shall call this function to notify the \a camera that
 * the request has completed. The request is no longer managed by the pipeline
 * handler and shall not be accessed once this function returns.
 *
 * This function ensures that requests will be returned to the application in
 * submission order, the pipeline handler may call it on any complete request
 * without any ordering constraint.
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::completeRequest

\brief Start capture from camera
 * \param[in] controls Controls to be applied before starting the Camera
 *
 * Start the camera capture session, optionally providing a list of controls to
 * apply before starting. Once the camera is started the application can queue
 * requests to the camera to process and return to the application until the
 * capture session is terminated with \a stop().
 *
 * \context This function may only be called when the camera is in the
 * Configured state as defined in \ref camera_operation, and shall be
 * synchronized by the caller with other functions that affect the camera
 * state.
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -ENODEV The camera has been disconnected from the system
 * \retval -EACCES The camera is not in a state where it can be started
 */
int Camera::start

\brief Start capture from camera
 * \param[in] controls Controls to be applied before starting the Camera
 *
 * Start the camera capture session, optionally providing a list of controls to
 * apply before starting. Once the camera is started the application can queue
 * requests to the camera to process and return to the application until the
 * capture session is terminated with \a stop().
 *
 * \context This function may only be called when the camera is in the
 * Configured state as defined in \ref camera_operation, and shall be
 * synchronized by the caller with other functions that affect the camera
 * state.
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -ENODEV The camera has been disconnected from the system
 * \retval -EACCES The camera is not in a state where it can be started
 */
int Camera::start
\todo Add documentation for camera start timings.

Functions that affect the camera state as defined below are generally not
 * synchronized with each other by the Camera class. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring their synchronization if necessary.
 *
 * \subsection Camera States

\brief Create a request object for the camera
 * \param[in] cookie Opaque cookie for application use
 *
 * This function creates an empty request for the application to fill with
 * buffers and parameters, and queue for capture.
 *
 * The \a cookie is stored in the request and is accessible through the
 * Request::cookie() function at any time. It is typically used by applications
 * to map the request to an external resource in the request completion
 * handler, and is completely opaque to libcamera.
 *
 * The ownership of the returned request is passed to the caller, which is
 * responsible for deleting it. The request may be deleted in the completion
 * handler, or reused after resetting its state with Request::reuse().
 *
 * \context This function is \threadsafe. It may only be called when the camera
 * is in the Configured or Running state as defined in \ref camera_operation.
 *
 * \return A pointer to the newly created request, or nullptr on error
 */
std::unique_ptr<Request> Camera::createRequest(uint64_t cookie)

\brief Start capture from camera
 * \param[in] controls Controls to be applied before starting the Camera
 *
 * Start the camera capture session, optionally providing a list of controls to
 * apply before starting. Once the camera is started the application can queue
 * requests to the camera to process and return to the application until the
 * capture session is terminated with \a stop().
 *
 * \context This function may only be called when the camera is in the
 * Configured state as defined in \ref camera_operation, and shall be
 * synchronized by the caller with other functions that affect the camera
 * state.
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -ENODEV The camera has been disconnected from the system
 * \retval -EACCES The camera is not in a state where it can be started
 */
int Camera::start(const ControlList *controls)

\fn PipelineHandler::queueRequestDevice()
 * \brief Queue a request to the device
 * \param[in] camera The camera to queue the request to
 * \param[in] request The request to queue
 *
 * This function queues a capture request to the device for processing. The
 * request contains a set of buffers associated with streams and a set of
 * parameters. The pipeline handler shall program the device to ensure that the
 * parameters will be applied to the frames captured in the buffers provided in
 * the request.
 *
 * \context This function is called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 */

\brief Complete a buffer for a request
 * \param[in] request The request the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The buffer that has completed
 *
 * This function shall be called by pipeline handlers to signal completion of
 * the \a buffer part of the \a request. It notifies applications of buffer
 * completion and updates the request's internal buffer tracking. The request
 * is not completed automatically when the last buffer completes to give
 * pipeline handlers a chance to perform any operation that may still be
 * needed. They shall complete requests explicitly with completeRequest().
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return True if all buffers contained in the request have completed, false
 * otherwise
 */
bool PipelineHandler::completeBuffer(Request *request, FrameBuffer *buffer)

findings.claim_quote: completeRequest checks requests from the front until queuedRequests_ is empty. If the status of the first request is RequestPending, it stops the loop and does not check the requests behind it. For a request that is not pending, it confirms that there are no pending buffers, removes it from the queue, and calls requestComplete() to return it to the application in submission order. This branch checks whether the request's status is Request::RequestPending and exits the loop if it is.

\brief Create a request object for the camera
 * \param[in] cookie Opaque cookie for application use
 *
 * This function creates an empty request for the application to fill with
 * buffers and parameters, and queue for capture.
 *
 * The \a cookie is stored in the request and is accessible through the
 * Request::cookie() function at any time. It is typically used by applications
 * to map the request to an external resource in the request completion
 * handler, and is completely opaque to libcamera.
 *
 * The ownership of the returned request is passed to the caller, which is
 * responsible for deleting it. The request may be deleted in the completion
 * handler, or reused after resetting its state with Request::reuse().
 *
 * \context This function is \threadsafe. It may only be called when the camera
 * is in the Configured or Running state as defined in \ref camera_operation.
 *
 * \return A pointer to the newly created request, or nullptr on error
 */
std::unique_ptr<Request> Camera::createRequest(uint64_t cookie)

\brief Add a FrameBuffer with its associated Stream to the Request
 * \param[in] stream The stream the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The FrameBuffer to add to the request
 * \param[in] fence The optional fence
 *
 * A reference to the buffer is stored in the request. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring that the buffer will remain valid until the request complete
 * callback is called.
 *
 * A request can only contain one buffer per stream. If a buffer has already
 * been added to the request for the same stream, this function returns -EEXIST.
 *
 * A Fence can be optionally associated with the \a buffer.
 *
 * When a valid Fence is provided to this function, \a fence is moved to \a
 * buffer and this Request will only be queued to the device once the
 * fences of all its buffers have been correctly signalled. Ownership of the
 * fence will only be taken in case of success, otherwise the fence will
 * be left unmodified.
 *
 * If the \a fence associated with \a buffer isn't signalled, the request will
 * fail after a timeout. The buffer will still contain the fence, which
 * applications must retrieve with FrameBuffer::releaseFence() before the buffer
 * can be reused in another request. Attempting to add a buffer that still
 * contains a fence to a request will result in this function returning -EEXIST.
 *
 * \sa FrameBuffer::releaseFence()
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -EEXIST The request already contains a buffer for the stream
 *  or the buffer still references a fence
 * \retval -EINVAL The buffer does not reference a valid Stream
 */
int Request::addBuffer(const Stream *stream, FrameBuffer *buffer,

\brief Add a FrameBuffer with its associated Stream to the Request
 * \param[in] stream The stream the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The FrameBuffer to add to the request
 * \param[in] fence The optional fence
 *
 * A reference to the buffer is stored in the request. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring that the buffer will remain valid until the request complete
 * callback is called.
 *
 * A request can only contain one buffer per stream. If a buffer has already
 * been added to the request for the same stream, this function returns -EEXIST.
 *
 * A Fence can be optionally associated with the \a buffer.
 *
 * When a valid Fence is provided to this function, \a fence is moved to \a
 * buffer and this Request will only be queued to the device once the
 * fences of all its buffers have been correctly signalled. Ownership of the
 * fence will only be taken in case of success, otherwise the fence will
 * be left unmodified.
 *
 * If the \a fence associated with \a buffer isn't signalled, the request will
 * fail after a timeout. The buffer will still contain the fence, which
 * applications must retrieve with FrameBuffer::releaseFence() before the buffer
 * can be reused in another request. Attempting to add a buffer that still
 * contains a fence to a request will result in this function returning -EEXIST.
 *
 * \sa FrameBuffer::releaseFence()
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -EEXIST The request already contains a buffer for the stream
 *  or the buffer still references a fence
 * \retval -EINVAL The buffer does not reference a valid Stream
 */
int Request::addBuffer(const Stream *stream, FrameBuffer *buffer,

\brief Add a FrameBuffer with its associated Stream to the Request
 * \param[in] stream The stream the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The FrameBuffer to add to the request
 * \param[in] fence The optional fence
 *
 * A reference to the buffer is stored in the request. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring that the buffer will remain valid until the request complete
 * callback is called.
 *
 * A request can only contain one buffer per stream. If a buffer has already
 * been added to the request for the same stream, this function returns -EEXIST.
 *
 * A Fence can be optionally associated with the \a buffer.
 *
 * When a valid Fence is provided to this function, \a fence is moved to \a
 * buffer and this Request will only be queued to the device once the
 * fences of all its buffers have been correctly signalled. Ownership of the
 * fence will only be taken in case of success, otherwise the fence will
 * be left unmodified.
 *
 * If the \a fence associated with \a buffer isn't signalled, the request will
 * fail after a timeout. The buffer will still contain the fence, which
 * applications must retrieve with FrameBuffer::releaseFence() before the buffer
 * can be reused in another request. Attempting to add a buffer that still
 * contains a fence to a request will result in this function returning -EEXIST.
 *
 * \sa FrameBuffer::releaseFence()
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -EEXIST The request already contains a buffer for the stream
 *  or the buffer still references a fence
 * \retval -EINVAL The buffer does not reference a valid Stream
 */
int Request::addBuffer(const Stream *stream, FrameBuffer *buffer,

\brief Complete a buffer for a request
 * \param[in] request The request the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The buffer that has completed
 *
 * This function shall be called by pipeline handlers to signal completion of
 * the \a buffer part of the \a request. It notifies applications of buffer
 * completion and updates the request's internal buffer tracking. The request
 * is not completed automatically when the last buffer completes to give
 * pipeline handlers a chance to perform any operation that may still be
 * needed. They shall complete requests explicitly with completeRequest().
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return True if all buffers contained in the request have completed, false
 * otherwise
 */
bool PipelineHandler::completeBuffer(Request *request, FrameBuffer *buffer)
{
	Camera *camera = request->_d()->camera();
	camera->bufferCompleted.emit(request, buffer);
	return request->_d()->completeBuffer(buffer);
}

\brief Complete a buffer for a request
 * \param[in] request The request the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The buffer that has completed
 *
 * This function shall be called by pipeline handlers to signal completion of
 * the \a buffer part of the \a request. It notifies applications of buffer
 * completion and updates the request's internal buffer tracking. The request
 * is not completed automatically when the last buffer completes to give
 * pipeline handlers a chance to perform any operation that may still be
 * needed. They shall complete requests explicitly with completeRequest().
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return True if all buffers contained in the request have completed, false
 * otherwise
 */
bool PipelineHandler::completeBuffer(Request *request, FrameBuffer *buffer)
{
	Camera *camera = request->_d()->camera();
	camera->bufferCompleted.emit(request, buffer);
	return request->_d()->completeBuffer(buffer);
}

overview.md/boundary/0.text: 호출자는 `Camera` 상태에 영향을 주는 함수들을 호출할 때 필요한 경우 함수들 사이의 동기화를 보장해야 합니다.

overview.md/request/1.text: 카메라는 `Camera::queueRequest()`로 큐에 넣은 요청의 처리가 끝나면 `requestCompleted` 신호로 애플리케이션에 완료를 알립니다.

overview.md/verification/1.text: `Camera::start` 호출자는 카메라 상태에 영향을 주는 다른 함수와 `Camera::start`를 동기화해야 합니다.

camera-model.md/concurrency/2.text: 호출자는 `Camera::start`와 `Camera::stop`을 각각 카메라 상태에 영향을 주는 다른 함수와 동기화해야 합니다.

camera-model.md/concurrency/3.text: 파이프라인 핸들러는 `completeBuffer()`와 `completeRequest()`를 `CameraManager` 스레드에서 호출해야 합니다. `cancelRequest()`에는 `completeRequest()`와 같은 규칙이 적용됩니다.

camera-model.md/concurrency/4.text: 파이프라인 핸들러는 요청이 완료되면 카메라에 알리기 위해 `Camera::requestComplete`를 호출합니다. 이 함수는 `requestCompleted.emit(request)`를 호출해 완료된 요청을 애플리케이션에 알리는 신호를 발행합니다.

camera-model.md/state/9.text: `Camera` 클래스는 카메라 상태에 영향을 주는 함수들을 일반적으로 서로 동기화하지 않습니다. 호출자는 필요한 경우 이 함수들의 동기화를 보장해야 합니다.

request-lifecycle.md/journey/2.text: `Camera::queueRequest`가 0을 반환하면 요청이 성공적으로 큐에 등록되었음을 의미합니다. 큐에 등록된 요청의 완료는 이후 requestCompleted 신호로 알립니다.

request-lifecycle.md/journey/8.text: 파이프라인 핸들러는 요청의 버퍼 완료를 알리기 위해 `CameraManager` 스레드에서 completeBuffer()를 호출해야 합니다. 마지막 버퍼가 완료되어도 요청은 자동으로 완료되지 않으므로 completeRequest()로 명시적으로 완료해야 합니다.

request-lifecycle.md/journey/10.text: completeRequest는 `queuedRequests_`가 빌 때까지 앞쪽 요청부터 확인합니다. 맨 앞 요청의 상태가 RequestPending이면 반복을 중단하므로 그 뒤의 요청은 확인하지 않습니다. 대기 중이 아닌 요청은 보류 중인 버퍼가 없음을 확인한 뒤 큐에서 제거하고 requestComplete()를 호출해 애플리케이션에 제출 순서대로 반환합니다.

request-lifecycle.md/resources/1.text: `Request::addBuffer()`는 요청에 버퍼의 참조를 저장합니다. 호출자는 요청 완료 콜백이 호출될 때까지 버퍼가 유효하게 유지되도록 해야 합니다.

request-lifecycle.md/stopping/6.text: 파이프라인 핸들러는 `completeRequest()`를 `CameraManager` 스레드에서 호출해야 합니다. 조사 계획으로, 기존 호출의 실행 문맥과 `queuedRequests_`의 맨 앞 요청 상태를 확인합니다. 맨 앞 요청이 `Request::RequestPending`이면 루프가 중단되며, 그렇지 않으면 해당 요청을 큐에서 꺼내 `camera->requestComplete(req)`를 호출합니다. 이 호출 이후 애플리케이션 콜백이 실제로 실행되는지는 별도로 확인합니다.

camera-requests.md/lifetime/0.text: `Request::addBuffer()`는 요청에 버퍼 참조를 저장합니다. 호출자는 요청 완료 콜백이 호출될 때까지 버퍼가 유효한 상태로 유지되도록 해야 합니다.

camera-requests.md/request/2.text: `Request::addBuffer()`를 호출하는 쪽은 요청 완료 콜백이 호출될 때까지 전달한 버퍼가 유효하게 유지되도록 해야 합니다.

camera-requests.md/request/9.text: `Camera::queueRequest()`는 요청을 카메라에 큐에 넣는 데 성공하면 0을 반환하고, 그 외에는 음수 오류 코드를 반환합니다. 요청이 큐에 들어간 후 카메라는 `requestCompleted` 신호로 요청의 완료를 알립니다.

pipeline-requests.md/completion/3.text: `completeRequest`는 요청을 제출 순서대로 애플리케이션에 반환하도록 합니다. 파이프라인 핸들러는 완료된 요청에 대해 순서 제약 없이 이 함수를 호출할 수 있습니다.

request-diagnosis.md/diagnosis/6.text: 조사 계획으로, 파이프라인 핸들러가 호출한 `completeBuffer`의 반환값을 확인합니다. 이 함수는 버퍼 완료를 애플리케이션에 알리고 요청의 내부 버퍼 추적을 갱신하며, 요청의 모든 버퍼가 완료되면 `true`, 그렇지 않으면 `false`를 반환합니다. 마지막 버퍼가 완료되어도 요청은 자동으로 완료되지 않으므로, 파이프라인 핸들러가 별도로 `completeRequest`를 호출했는지 확인합니다. 파이프라인 핸들러는 두 함수를 `CameraManager` 스레드에서 호출해야 합니다.

scenarios/queue_request.md/paragraph/14.text: 조건 분기, 반복 횟수와 실제 실행 스레드는 이 호출 목록만으로 확정할 수 없습니다. 가상 호출 후보는 실제 객체에 따라 선택됩니다. 예약 표시는 인자로 전달한 메서드 대상을 뜻하며, 비동기 실행을 보증하지 않습니다. 호출부의 연결 방식과 동기화 계약을 확인해야 합니다.

catalog/3224a8227a269130.text: 애플리케이션은 촬영을 준비하기 위해 카메라를 확보하고 구성한 뒤 시작하고, 카메라가 요청을 처리하다가 정지된 후 사용을 마치면 카메라를 해제해야 합니다. 애플리케이션은 카메라를 해제하지 않은 동안 여러 번 시작하고 정지할 수 있으며, 카메라를 재구성할 수도 있습니다. Camera 클래스는 카메라 상태에 영향을 주는 함수들을 일반적으로 서로 동기화하지 않으므로, 필요한 경우 호출자가 이 함수들을 동기화해야 합니다. PipelineHandler::match() 구현자는 단일 파이프라인에 필요한 미디어 장치를 모두 확보한 경우 하나 이상의 Camera 인스턴스를 생성하고 내부에 저장하며 카메라 관리자에 등록해야 합니다.

catalog/3224a8227a269130/en.text: To prepare for capture, the application must acquire and configure the camera, then start it. After the camera has processed requests and been stopped, the application must release it when it has finished using it. The application may start and stop the camera multiple times without releasing it, and may also reconfigure it. The Camera class generally does not synchronize functions that affect camera state with one another, so the caller must synchronize these functions when necessary. When a PipelineHandler::match() implementer has acquired all media devices required for a single pipeline, the implementer must create and store one or more Camera instances internally and register them with the camera manager.

catalog/7a75740664d08f7d.text: PipelineHandler::match() 구현자는 단일 파이프라인에 필요한 미디어 장치를 모두 찾으면 각 장치를 MediaDevice::acquire()로 확보한 다음 해당 Camera 인스턴스를 하나 이상 생성하여 내부에 저장하고 카메라 매니저에 등록한 뒤 true를 반환해야 합니다. PipelineHandler::match() 구현자는 필요한 미디어 장치를 모두 찾지 못했을 때 아직 장치를 확보하지 않았다면 어떤 장치도 확보해서는 안 되며, 이미 일부를 확보했다면 MediaDevice::release()를 호출해 확보한 장치를 모두 해제하고 false를 반환해야 합니다. PipelineHandler::match()는 CameraManager 스레드에서 호출되며, true를 반환하면 새 PipelineHandler 인스턴스를 생성하고 그 인스턴스의 match()를 호출합니다.

catalog/7a75740664d08f7d/en.text: When the PipelineHandler::match() implementer finds all media devices required for a single pipeline, the implementer must acquire each device using MediaDevice::acquire(), then create one or more corresponding Camera instances, store them internally, register them with the camera manager, and return true. If the PipelineHandler::match() implementer cannot find all required media devices and has not yet acquired any devices, the implementer must not acquire any devices. If the implementer has already acquired some, the implementer must call MediaDevice::release() to release all acquired devices and return false. PipelineHandler::match() is called on the CameraManager thread, and when it returns true, a new PipelineHandler instance is created and its match() is called.

catalog/e2896d9b796995ac.text: generateConfiguration 호출자는 기본 구성을 가져오려는 사용 사례를 roles에 채워야 합니다. generateConfiguration()이 반환하는 구성에는 선택된 스트림과 해당 스트림의 기본 파라미터에 관한 정보가 포함됩니다. PipelineHandler::generateConfiguration()은 요청된 roles를 충족할 수 있으면 유효한 CameraConfiguration을 반환해야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 null 포인터를 반환해야 합니다. PipelineHandler::generateConfiguration()은 어떤 스레드에서든 호출될 수 있으며, 구현은 스레드에 안전해야 합니다.

catalog/e2896d9b796995ac/en.text: The caller of generateConfiguration must populate roles with the use cases for which it wants to obtain a default configuration. The configuration returned by generateConfiguration() contains information about the selected streams and their default parameters. PipelineHandler::generateConfiguration() must return a valid CameraConfiguration if it can satisfy the requested roles, and must return a null pointer otherwise. PipelineHandler::generateConfiguration() may be called from any thread, and the implementation must be thread-safe.

catalog/463b51721e3a9400.text: PipelineHandler::configure()의 구현자는 카메라를 구성할 때 StreamConfiguration::setStream()을 사용해 CameraConfiguration의 각 StreamConfiguration 항목에 Stream 인스턴스를 연결해야 합니다. PipelineHandler::configure()는 CameraManager 스레드에서 호출되며, 구현은 성공하면 0을 반환하고 실패하면 음수 오류 코드를 반환해야 합니다.

catalog/463b51721e3a9400/en.text: When configuring a camera, the implementer of PipelineHandler::configure() must use StreamConfiguration::setStream() to associate a Stream instance with each StreamConfiguration entry in CameraConfiguration. PipelineHandler::configure() is called on the CameraManager thread, and the implementation must return 0 on success and a negative error code on failure.

catalog/1904fe425d4c9ab3.text: queueRequestDevice 구현자는 스트림과 연결된 버퍼 집합과 파라미터 집합을 담은 요청을 처리할 때, 요청에서 제공한 버퍼에 캡처되는 프레임에 해당 파라미터가 적용되도록 장치를 설정해야 합니다. queueRequestDevice 구현자는 성공하면 0을 반환하고, 실패하면 음수 오류 코드를 반환해야 합니다. PipelineHandler::queueRequestDevice()는 CameraManager 스레드에서 호출됩니다. 파이프라인 핸들러는 요청의 버퍼 완료를 애플리케이션에 알리고 요청의 내부 버퍼 추적을 갱신하려면 CameraManager 스레드에서 completeBuffer()를 호출해야 합니다.

catalog/1904fe425d4c9ab3/en.text: When processing a request containing a set of buffers associated with streams and a set of parameters, the queueRequestDevice implementer must configure the device so that those parameters are applied to the frames captured into the buffers supplied in the request. The queueRequestDevice implementer must return 0 on success and a negative error code on failure. PipelineHandler::queueRequestDevice() is called on the CameraManager thread. The pipeline handler must call completeBuffer() on the CameraManager thread to notify the application that a request's buffer has completed and update the request's internal buffer tracking.

catalog/19d447cf06fa9450.text: completeBuffer에서 마지막 버퍼가 완료되어도 요청은 자동으로 완료되지 않으며, 파이프라인 핸들러가 completeRequest()로 요청을 명시적으로 완료해야 합니다. 파이프라인 핸들러는 요청을 완료하려면 completeRequest()를 명시적으로 호출해야 합니다. 파이프라인 핸들러는 completeBuffer를 CameraManager 스레드에서 호출해야 합니다.

catalog/19d447cf06fa9450/en.text: In completeBuffer, even when the last buffer completes, the request does not complete automatically; the pipeline handler must explicitly complete the request using completeRequest(). The pipeline handler must explicitly call completeRequest() to complete the request. The pipeline handler must call completeBuffer from the CameraManager thread.

catalog/3ada1076f0d94452.text: IPAManager::module은 modules_를 순회하며 이름과 최소·최대 버전에 match하는 첫 번째 모듈의 포인터를 반환합니다. 일치하는 모듈이 없으면 module은 nullptr을 반환합니다. createIPA는 이 검색 결과가 없으면 nullptr을 반환합니다. createIPA 내부 람다는 isSignatureValid(m)이 참이면 T::Threaded 프록시를 생성하고, 거짓이면 T::Isolated 프록시를 생성합니다.

catalog/3ada1076f0d94452/en.text: IPAManager::module iterates over modules_ and returns a pointer to the first module that match the name and minimum and maximum versions. If no module matches, module returns nullptr. createIPA returns nullptr if the search produces no result. The lambda inside createIPA creates a T::Threaded proxy if isSignatureValid(m) is true and a T::Isolated proxy if it is false.

catalog/492fb91a4cdc1e48.text: 파이프라인 핸들러 구현자는 completeRequest가 반환된 뒤 해당 요청을 더 이상 관리하지 않으며 접근해서는 안 됩니다. 파이프라인 핸들러는 완료된 요청을 순서 제약 없이 completeRequest에 전달할 수 있으며, 이 함수는 요청을 제출 순서대로 애플리케이션에 반환합니다. 호출자는 completeRequest를 CameraManager 스레드에서 호출해야 합니다.

catalog/492fb91a4cdc1e48/en.text: Pipeline handler implementers no longer manage the request after completeRequest returns and must not access it. A pipeline handler may pass completed requests to completeRequest without ordering constraints, and this function returns the requests to the application in submission order. The caller must call completeRequest from the CameraManager thread.

catalog/0e76a408a528a618.text: 애플리케이션은 Camera::queueRequest()에 요청을 전달하기 전에 요청에 캡처 버퍼를 하나 이상 채워야 합니다. 카메라는 Camera::queueRequest()로 큐에 넣은 요청의 처리가 끝나면 requestCompleted 신호로 애플리케이션에 완료를 알립니다. Camera::queueRequest()는 카메라가 Running 상태일 때만 호출해야 합니다.

catalog/0e76a408a528a618/en.text: The application must populate the request with at least one capture buffer before passing it to Camera::queueRequest(). When the camera finishes processing a request queued with Camera::queueRequest(), it notifies the application of completion through the requestCompleted signal. Camera::queueRequest() must only be called when the camera is in the Running state.

catalog/c2d18b3ad493b9ef.text: 호출자는 Camera 상태에 영향을 주는 함수들을 호출할 때 필요한 경우 함수들 사이의 동기화를 보장해야 합니다. 파이프라인 핸들러는 PipelineHandler::completeRequest()를 CameraManager 스레드에서 호출해야 합니다.

catalog/c2d18b3ad493b9ef/en.text: The caller must ensure synchronization between functions when necessary when calling functions that affect the state of Camera. The pipeline handler must call PipelineHandler::completeRequest() on the CameraManager thread.

catalog/5fbfdd4a0d724d00.text: Camera::start는 isAccessAllowed에 허용 상태 값으로 Private::CameraConfigured를 전달합니다. Camera::start 호출자는 카메라 상태에 영향을 주는 다른 함수와 Camera::start를 동기화해야 합니다. 이 TODO 주석은 카메라 시작 타이밍의 문서화를 요청합니다.

catalog/5fbfdd4a0d724d00/en.text: Camera::start passes Private::CameraConfigured to isAccessAllowed as the allowed state value. Callers of Camera::start must synchronize Camera::start with other functions that affect the camera state. This TODO comment requests documentation of camera start timing.

catalog/fafe0c24c5437672.text: Camera 클래스는 카메라 상태에 영향을 주는 함수들을 일반적으로 서로 동기화하지 않습니다. 호출자는 필요한 경우 이 함수들의 동기화를 보장해야 합니다.

catalog/fafe0c24c5437672/en.text: The Camera class generally does not synchronize functions that affect camera state with one another. Callers must ensure synchronization of these functions when necessary.

catalog/71d625cc71d6b2fe.text: Camera::createRequest()는 스레드 안전 함수입니다. Camera::queueRequest()는 스레드 안전 함수입니다. 호출자는 Camera::start와 Camera::stop을 각각 카메라 상태에 영향을 주는 다른 함수와 동기화해야 합니다.

catalog/71d625cc71d6b2fe/en.text: Camera::createRequest() is a thread-safe function. Camera::queueRequest() is a thread-safe function. The caller must synchronize Camera::start and Camera::stop respectively with other functions that affect the camera state.

catalog/2fc3456c63f26639.text: 파이프라인 핸들러는 completeBuffer()와 completeRequest()를 CameraManager 스레드에서 호출해야 합니다. cancelRequest()에는 completeRequest()와 같은 규칙이 적용됩니다. 파이프라인 핸들러는 요청이 완료되면 카메라에 알리기 위해 Camera::requestComplete를 호출합니다. 이 함수는 requestCompleted.emit(request)를 호출해 완료된 요청을 애플리케이션에 알리는 신호를 발행합니다.

catalog/2fc3456c63f26639/en.text: The pipeline handler must call completeBuffer() and completeRequest() on the CameraManager thread. The same rules as for completeRequest() apply to cancelRequest(). The pipeline handler calls Camera::requestComplete to notify the camera when a request completes. This function calls requestCompleted.emit(request) to emit a signal notifying the application of the completed request.

catalog/05acb1c6533f9b85.text: Camera::queueRequest가 0을 반환하면 요청이 성공적으로 큐에 등록되었음을 의미합니다. 큐에 등록된 요청의 완료는 이후 requestCompleted 신호로 알립니다. waitingRequests_는 준비를 기다리는 요청을 순서대로 보관하며, 맨 앞의 요청이 준비되지 않으면 후속 요청의 장치 전달을 멈춥니다. maxQueuedRequestsDevice_는 장치에 전달된 요청의 최대 개수를 정하며, 장치 큐의 요청 수가 이 값에 도달하면 추가 전달을 멈춥니다.

catalog/05acb1c6533f9b85/en.text: If Camera::queueRequest returns 0, the request was successfully queued. Completion of the queued request is subsequently reported through the requestCompleted signal. waitingRequests_ holds requests waiting to become ready in order, and stops delivering subsequent requests to the device if the first request is not ready. maxQueuedRequestsDevice_ sets the maximum number of requests delivered to the device, and further delivery stops when the number of requests in the device queue reaches this value.

catalog/d63525c4cb9229b5.text: 오류 시 음수 오류 코드를 반환합니다. 파이프라인 핸들러는 요청의 버퍼 완료를 알리기 위해 CameraManager 스레드에서 completeBuffer()를 호출해야 합니다. 마지막 버퍼가 완료되어도 요청은 자동으로 완료되지 않으므로 completeRequest()로 명시적으로 완료해야 합니다. 마지막 버퍼가 완료되어도 요청은 자동으로 완료되지 않으며, 파이프라인 핸들러는 completeRequest()를 명시적으로 호출하여 요청을 완료해야 합니다.

catalog/d63525c4cb9229b5/en.text: Returns a negative error code on error. The pipeline handler must call completeBuffer() from the CameraManager thread to signal completion of a buffer in the request. Even when the last buffer is completed, the request is not completed automatically and must be explicitly completed with completeRequest(). Even when the last buffer is completed, the request is not completed automatically, and the pipeline handler must explicitly call completeRequest() to complete it.

catalog/43a224a8fdca88b8.text: completeRequest는 queuedRequests_가 빌 때까지 앞쪽 요청부터 확인합니다. 맨 앞 요청의 상태가 RequestPending이면 반복을 중단하므로 그 뒤의 요청은 확인하지 않습니다. 대기 중이 아닌 요청은 보류 중인 버퍼가 없음을 확인한 뒤 큐에서 제거하고 requestComplete()를 호출해 애플리케이션에 제출 순서대로 반환합니다. 이 분기는 요청의 상태가 Request::RequestPending인지 판단하며, 같으면 반복문을 종료합니다.

catalog/43a224a8fdca88b8/en.text: completeRequest checks requests from the front until queuedRequests_ is empty. If the status of the first request is RequestPending, it stops the loop and does not check the requests behind it. For a request that is not pending, it confirms that there are no pending buffers, removes it from the queue, and calls requestComplete() to return it to the application in submission order. This branch checks whether the request's status is Request::RequestPending and exits the loop if it is.

catalog/17213e255910fe0b.text: Camera::createRequest()가 반환한 요청의 소유권은 호출자에게 넘어가며, 호출자는 요청을 삭제할 책임이 있습니다. 호출자는 완료 핸들러에서 요청을 삭제하거나 Request::reuse()로 상태를 초기화한 뒤 재사용할 수 있습니다. Request::addBuffer()는 요청에 버퍼의 참조를 저장합니다. 호출자는 요청 완료 콜백이 호출될 때까지 버퍼가 유효하게 유지되도록 해야 합니다.

catalog/17213e255910fe0b/en.text: Ownership of the request returned by Camera::createRequest() passes to the caller, who is responsible for deleting it. The caller may delete the request in the completion handler or reset its state with Request::reuse() and reuse it. Request::addBuffer() stores a reference to the buffer in the request. The caller must ensure that the buffer remains valid until the request completion callback is called.

catalog/d5af8774153f28f6.text: 파이프라인 핸들러는 completeRequest()를 CameraManager 스레드에서 호출해야 합니다. 조사 계획으로, 기존 호출의 실행 문맥과 queuedRequests_의 맨 앞 요청 상태를 확인합니다. 맨 앞 요청이 Request::RequestPending이면 루프가 중단되며, 그렇지 않으면 해당 요청을 큐에서 꺼내 camera->requestComplete(req)를 호출합니다. 이 호출 이후 애플리케이션 콜백이 실제로 실행되는지는 별도로 확인합니다.

catalog/d5af8774153f28f6/en.text: The pipeline handler must call completeRequest() from the CameraManager thread. As an investigation plan, check the execution context of the existing call and the state of the first request in queuedRequests_. If the first request is Request::RequestPending, the loop stops; otherwise, that request is removed from the queue and camera->requestComplete(req) is called. Separately check whether the application callback actually runs after this call.

catalog/9e35b9d0edb41f98.text: Request::addBuffer()의 호출자는 한 요청에 스트림당 버퍼를 하나만 연결해야 합니다. 같은 스트림의 버퍼가 이미 요청에 추가되어 있으면 Request::addBuffer()는 -EEXIST를 반환합니다. Request::addBuffer()를 호출하는 쪽은 요청 완료 콜백이 호출될 때까지 전달한 버퍼가 유효하게 유지되도록 해야 합니다.

catalog/9e35b9d0edb41f98/en.text: The caller of Request::addBuffer() must attach only one buffer per stream to a request. If a buffer for the same stream has already been added to the request, Request::addBuffer() returns -EEXIST. The caller of Request::addBuffer() must ensure that the passed buffer remains valid until the request completion callback is called.

catalog/4119efe0a1757fd2.text: Camera::queueRequest()는 activeStreams_.find(stream)의 결과가 activeStreams_.end()와 같으면 해당 스트림이 없다고 판단하고 -EINVAL을 반환합니다. Camera::queueRequest()는 요청을 카메라에 큐에 넣는 데 성공하면 0을 반환하고, 그 외에는 음수 오류 코드를 반환합니다. 요청이 큐에 들어간 후 카메라는 requestCompleted 신호로 요청의 완료를 알립니다.

catalog/4119efe0a1757fd2/en.text: If the result of activeStreams_.find(stream) equals activeStreams_.end(), Camera::queueRequest() determines that the stream does not exist and returns -EINVAL. Camera::queueRequest() returns 0 if it successfully queues the request to the camera; otherwise, it returns a negative error code. After the request is queued, the camera signals its completion with the requestCompleted signal.

catalog/0f4906a6590fd2db.text: Request::addBuffer()는 요청에 버퍼 참조를 저장합니다. 호출자는 요청 완료 콜백이 호출될 때까지 버퍼가 유효한 상태로 유지되도록 해야 합니다. Request::addBuffer()가 성공하면 전달된 유효한 Fence의 소유권이 buffer로 이동합니다. Request::addBuffer()가 실패하면 전달받은 fence의 소유권을 가져가지 않고 fence를 변경하지 않은 그대로 둡니다.

catalog/0f4906a6590fd2db/en.text: Request::addBuffer() stores a buffer reference in the request. The caller must ensure that the buffer remains valid until the request completion callback is invoked. If Request::addBuffer() succeeds, ownership of the valid Fence passed to it transfers to buffer. If Request::addBuffer() fails, it does not take ownership of the passed fence and leaves fence unchanged.

catalog/11bfecb773e66367.text: PipelineHandler::registerRequest()는 요청이 생성될 때 호출되며, 파이프라인 핸들러가 해당 요청에 필요한 일회성 초기화를 수행할 기회를 제공합니다. PipelineHandler::registerRequest()가 prepared 신호에 연결한 콜백은 doQueueRequests()를 호출합니다. PipelineHandler::queueRequest는 요청에 연결된 카메라의 내부 waitingRequests_ 목록에 요청을 추가합니다. PipelineHandler::queueRequest는 prepare에 시간 인자로 300ms, 즉 300밀리초를 전달합니다.

catalog/11bfecb773e66367/en.text: PipelineHandler::registerRequest() is called when a request is created, giving the pipeline handler an opportunity to perform one-time initialization required for that request. The callback that PipelineHandler::registerRequest() connected to the prepared signal calls doQueueRequests(). PipelineHandler::queueRequest adds the request to the internal waitingRequests_ list of the camera associated with the request. PipelineHandler::queueRequest passes 300ms, or 300 milliseconds, as the time argument to prepare.

catalog/dad21cd1a3542a22.text: 파이프라인 핸들러는 completeRequest가 반환한 뒤 해당 요청에 접근해서는 안 됩니다. 반환 후에는 파이프라인 핸들러가 그 요청을 더 이상 관리하지 않습니다. completeRequest는 요청을 제출 순서대로 애플리케이션에 반환하도록 합니다. 파이프라인 핸들러는 완료된 요청에 대해 순서 제약 없이 이 함수를 호출할 수 있습니다.

catalog/dad21cd1a3542a22/en.text: The pipeline handler must not access the request after completeRequest returns. After it returns, the pipeline handler no longer manages that request. completeRequest ensures that requests are returned to the application in submission order. The pipeline handler may call this function for completed requests without ordering constraints.

catalog/3fc78c4767c9bb29.text: PipelineHandler::completeRequest()의 while 루프는 큐 맨 앞 요청의 상태가 Request::RequestPending이면 break를 실행하여 루프를 중단합니다. completeRequest는 대기 중인 요청을 파이프라인에 큐에 넣을 수 있도록 마지막에 doQueueRequests(camera)를 호출합니다. 파이프라인 핸들러는 completeBuffer와 completeRequest를 CameraManager 스레드에서 호출해야 합니다. PipelineHandler::cancelRequest는 먼저 request->_d()->cancel()을 호출하고, 이어서 completeRequest(request)를 호출합니다.

catalog/3fc78c4767c9bb29/en.text: The while loop in PipelineHandler::completeRequest() executes break to break out of the loop if the status of the request at the front of the queue is Request::RequestPending. completeRequest calls doQueueRequests(camera) at the end so that pending requests can be queued to the pipeline. The pipeline handler must call completeBuffer and completeRequest from the CameraManager thread. PipelineHandler::cancelRequest first calls request->_d()->cancel() and then calls completeRequest(request).

catalog/512e5d3077ee1ee4.text: 조사 계획으로, 파이프라인 핸들러가 호출한 completeBuffer의 반환값을 확인합니다. 이 함수는 버퍼 완료를 애플리케이션에 알리고 요청의 내부 버퍼 추적을 갱신하며, 요청의 모든 버퍼가 완료되면 true, 그렇지 않으면 false를 반환합니다. 마지막 버퍼가 완료되어도 요청은 자동으로 완료되지 않으므로, 파이프라인 핸들러가 별도로 completeRequest를 호출했는지 확인합니다. 파이프라인 핸들러는 두 함수를 CameraManager 스레드에서 호출해야 합니다.

catalog/512e5d3077ee1ee4/en.text: As an investigation plan, check the return value of completeBuffer called by the pipeline handler. This function notifies the application of buffer completion and updates the request's internal buffer tracking. It returns true if all buffers in the request are complete, and false otherwise. Even when the last buffer is complete, the request is not completed automatically, so check whether the pipeline handler separately called completeRequest. The pipeline handler must call both functions from the CameraManager thread.

catalog/2eace40003f58d25.text: 조건 분기, 반복 횟수와 실제 실행 스레드는 이 호출 목록만으로 확정할 수 없습니다. 가상 호출 후보는 실제 객체에 따라 선택됩니다. 예약 표시는 인자로 전달한 메서드 대상을 뜻하며, 비동기 실행을 보증하지 않습니다. 호출부의 연결 방식과 동기화 계약을 확인해야 합니다.

catalog/2eace40003f58d25/en.text: Conditional branches, repeat counts, and the actual execution thread cannot be determined from this call list alone. Virtual call candidates are selected depending on the actual object. The scheduling marker refers to the method target passed as an argument and does not guarantee asynchronous execution. The call site's connection method and synchronization contract must be checked.

overview/boundary/synchronization.text:
Functions that affect the camera state as defined below are generally not
 * synchronized with each other by the Camera class. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring their synchronization if necessary.
 *
 * \subsection Camera States

overview/boundary/completion.text:
\brief Signal request completion
 * \param[in] request The request that has completed
 *
 * The pipeline handler shall call this function to notify the \a camera that
 * the request has completed. The request is no longer managed by the pipeline
 * handler and shall not be accessed once this function returns.
 *
 * This function ensures that requests will be returned to the application in
 * submission order, the pipeline handler may call it on any complete request
 * without any ordering constraint.
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::completeRequest

vendor-integration/request/completion-co.text:
\brief Complete a buffer for a request
 * \param[in] request The request the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The buffer that has completed
 *
 * This function shall be called by pipeline handlers to signal completion of
 * the \a buffer part of the \a request. It notifies applications of buffer
 * completion and updates the request's internal buffer tracking. The request
 * is not completed automatically when the last buffer completes to give
 * pipeline handlers a chance to perform any operation that may still be
 * needed. They shall complete requests explicitly with completeRequest().
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return True if all buffers contained in the request have completed, false
 * otherwise
 */
bool PipelineHandler::completeBuffer

camera-model/concurrency/create.text:
\brief Create a request object for the camera
 * \param[in] cookie Opaque cookie for application use
 *
 * This function creates an empty request for the application to fill with
 * buffers and parameters, and queue for capture.
 *
 * The \a cookie is stored in the request and is accessible through the
 * Request::cookie() function at any time. It is typically used by applications
 * to map the request to an external resource in the request completion
 * handler, and is completely opaque to libcamera.
 *
 * The ownership of the returned request is passed to the caller, which is
 * responsible for deleting it. The request may be deleted in the completion
 * handler, or reused after resetting its state with Request::reuse().
 *
 * \context This function is \threadsafe. It may only be called when the camera
 * is in the Configured or Running state as defined in \ref camera_operation.
 *
 * \return A pointer to the newly created request, or nullptr on error
 */
std::unique_ptr<Request> Camera::createRequest(uint64_t cookie)

camera-model/concurrency/start.text:
\brief Start capture from camera
 * \param[in] controls Controls to be applied before starting the Camera
 *
 * Start the camera capture session, optionally providing a list of controls to
 * apply before starting. Once the camera is started the application can queue
 * requests to the camera to process and return to the application until the
 * capture session is terminated with \a stop().
 *
 * \context This function may only be called when the camera is in the
 * Configured state as defined in \ref camera_operation, and shall be
 * synchronized by the caller with other functions that affect the camera
 * state.
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -ENODEV The camera has been disconnected from the system
 * \retval -EACCES The camera is not in a state where it can be started
 */
int Camera::start(const ControlList *controls)

vendor-integration/boundary/repeat.text:
\fn PipelineHandler::match(DeviceEnumerator *enumerator)
 * \brief Match media devices and create camera instances
 * \param[in] enumerator The enumerator providing all media devices found in the
 * system
 *
 * This function is the main entry point of the pipeline handler. It is called
 * by the camera manager with the \a enumerator passed as an argument. It shall
 * acquire from the \a enumerator all the media devices it needs for a single
 * pipeline, create one or multiple Camera instances and register them with the
 * camera manager.
 *
 * If all media devices needed by the pipeline handler are found, they must all
 * be acquired by a call to MediaDevice::acquire(). This function shall then
 * create the corresponding Camera instances, store them internally, and return
 * true. Otherwise it shall not acquire any media device (or shall release all
 * the media devices is has acquired by calling MediaDevice::release()) and
 * return false.
 *
 * If multiple instances of a pipeline are available in the system, the
 * PipelineHandler class will be instantiated once per instance, and its match()
 * function called for every instance. Each call shall acquire media devices for
 * one pipeline instance, until all compatible media devices are exhausted.
 *
 * If this function returns true, a new instance of the pipeline handler will
 * be created and its match() function called.
 *
 * \context This function is called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return true if media devices have been acquired and camera instances
 * created, or false otherwise
 */

vendor-integration/configuration/generat.text:
\fn PipelineHandler::generateConfiguration()
 * \brief Generate a camera configuration for a specified camera
 * \param[in] camera The camera to generate a default configuration for
 * \param[in] roles A list of stream roles
 *
 * Generate a default configuration for the \a camera for a specified list of
 * stream roles. The caller shall populate the \a roles with the use-cases it
 * wishes to fetch the default configuration for. The returned configuration
 * can then be examined by the caller to learn about the selected streams and
 * their default parameters.
 *
 * The intended companion to this is \a configure() which can be used to change
 * the group of streams parameters.
 *
 * \context This function may be called from any thread and shall be
 * \threadsafe. It shall not modify the state of the \a camera in the pipeline
 * handler.
 *
 * \return A valid CameraConfiguration if the requested roles can be satisfied,
 * or a null pointer otherwise.
 */

vendor-integration/configuration/configu.text:
\fn PipelineHandler::configure()
 * \brief Configure a group of streams for capture
 * \param[in] camera The camera to configure
 * \param[in] config The camera configurations to setup
 *
 * Configure the specified group of streams for \a camera according to the
 * configuration specified in \a config. The intended caller of this interface
 * is the Camera class which will receive configuration to apply from the
 * application.
 *
 * The configuration is guaranteed to have been validated with
 * CameraConfiguration::validate(). The pipeline handler implementation shall
 * not perform further validation and may rely on any custom field stored in its
 * custom CameraConfiguration derived class.
 *
 * When configuring the camera the pipeline handler shall associate a Stream
 * instance to each StreamConfiguration entry in the CameraConfiguration using
 * the StreamConfiguration::setStream() function.
 *
 * \context This function is called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 */

Functions that affect the camera state as defined below are generally not

vendor-integration/request/device-result.text:
\fn PipelineHandler::queueRequestDevice()
 * \brief Queue a request to the device
 * \param[in] camera The camera to queue the request to
 * \param[in] request The request to queue
 *
 * This function queues a capture request to the device for processing. The
 * request contains a set of buffers associated with streams and a set of
 * parameters. The pipeline handler shall program the device to ensure that the
 * parameters will be applied to the frames captured in the buffers provided in
 * the request.
 *
 * \context This function is called from the CameraManager thread.

 */

overview/request/queue.text:
\brief Queue a request to the camera
 * \param[in] request The request to queue to the camera
 *
 * This function queues a \a request to the camera for capture.
 *
 * After allocating the request with createRequest(), the application shall
 * fill it with at least one capture buffer before queuing it. Requests that
 * contain no buffers are invalid and are rejected without being queued.
 *
 * Once the request has been queued, the camera will notify its completion
 * through the \ref requestCompleted signal.
 *
 * \context This function is \threadsafe. It may only be called when the camera
 * is in the Running state as defined in \ref camera_operation.
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -ENODEV The camera has been disconnected from the system
 * \retval -EACCES The camera is not running so requests can't be queued
 * \retval -EXDEV The request does not belong to this camera
 * \retval -EINVAL The request is invalid
 * \retval -ENOMEM No buffer memory was available to handle the request
 */
int Camera::queueRequest

overview/verification/caller-synchroniza.text:

 * requests to the camera to process and return to the application until the
 * capture session is terminated with \a stop().
 *
 * \context This function may only be called when the camera is in the
 * Configured state as defined in \ref camera_operation, and shall be
 * synchronized by the caller with other functions that affect the camera
 * state.
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -ENODEV The camera has been disconnected from the system
 * \retval -EACCES The camera is not in a state where it can be started

int Camera::start

request-lifecycle/journey/buffer-notice.text:
\brief Complete a buffer for a request
 * \param[in] request The request the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The buffer that has completed
 *
 * This function shall be called by pipeline handlers to signal completion of
 * the \a buffer part of the \a request. It notifies applications of buffer
 * completion and updates the request's internal buffer tracking. The request
 * is not completed automatically when the last buffer completes to give
 * pipeline handlers a chance to perform any operation that may still be
 * needed. They shall complete requests explicitly with completeRequest().
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return True if all buffers contained in the request have completed, false
 * otherwise
 */
bool PipelineHandler::completeBuffer(Request *request, FrameBuffer *buffer)

request-lifecycle/resources/buffer-duty.text:
\brief Add a FrameBuffer with its associated Stream to the Request
 * \param[in] stream The stream the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The FrameBuffer to add to the request
 * \param[in] fence The optional fence
 *
 * A reference to the buffer is stored in the request. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring that the buffer will remain valid until the request complete
 * callback is called.
 *
 * A request can only contain one buffer per stream. If a buffer has already
 * been added to the request for the same stream, this function returns -EEXIST.
 *
 * A Fence can be optionally associated with the \a buffer.
 *
 * When a valid Fence is provided to this function, \a fence is moved to \a
 * buffer and this Request will only be queued to the device once the
 * fences of all its buffers have been correctly signalled. Ownership of the
 * fence will only be taken in case of success, otherwise the fence will
 * be left unmodified.
 *
 * If the \a fence associated with \a buffer isn't signalled, the request will
 * fail after a timeout. The buffer will still contain the fence, which

pipeline-requests/completion/ordering-co.text:
This function ensures that requests will be returned to the application in
 * submission order, the pipeline handler may call it on any complete request
 * without any ordering constraint.

pipeline-requests/completion/buffer-cont.text:
\brief Complete a buffer for a request
 * \param[in] request The request the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The buffer that has completed
 *
 * This function shall be called by pipeline handlers to signal completion of
 * the \a buffer part of the \a request. It notifies applications of buffer
 * completion and updates the request's internal buffer tracking. The request
 * is not completed automatically when the last buffer completes to give
 * pipeline handlers a chance to perform any operation that may still be
 * needed. They shall complete requests explicitly with completeRequest().
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return True if all buffers contained in the request have completed, false
 * otherwise
 */
bool PipelineHandler::completeBuffer(Request *request, FrameBuffer *buffer)
{
	Camera *camera = request->_d()->camera();
	camera->bufferCompleted.emit(request, buffer);
	return request->_d()->completeBuffer(buffer);
}

vendor-integration/integration/camera.text:
An application needs to perform a sequence of operations on a camera before
 * it is ready to process requests. The camera needs to be acquired and
 * configured to prepare the camera for capture. Once started the camera can
 * process requests until it is stopped. When an application is done with a
 * camera, the camera needs to be released.

vendor-integration/integration/restart.text:
An application may start and stop a camera multiple times as long as it is
 * not released. The camera may also be reconfigured.
